The Eastern Charlotte Kingfishers are a Tier II junior ice hockey team playing in the United States Premier Hockey League's (USPHL) National Collegiate Development Conference (NCDC) division. The Kingfishers play their home games at Eastern Charlotte Recreation Centre in Blacks Harbour, New Brunswick.
History
In 2025, the USPHL announced their sizable foray into Canada with addition of six new franchises from north of the border. Two of the new franchises, both based in Charlotte County, New Brunswick, were owned by Ted Colley. In June, the names and logos of both teams were revealed with the one from Blacks Harbour, New Brunswick being called the Eastern Charlotte Kingfishers.
